Here’s a fact that might fit the bill:

**"The average person blinks about 15 to 20 times per minute, which adds up to roughly 1,200 times per hour or 28,800 times per day."**

It’s true, but unless you’re deeply fascinated by human biology or blink rates, it’s probably not the most thrilling tidbit. Want something even more niche? I can dig deeper!
